snippet.title: Lan Party Adventures Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566720/LAN_Party_Adventures/

Step into the early 2000s as a young tech geek whose life revolves around setting up epic LAN parties and troubleshooting retro tech. Things take a dark twist when a close friend vanishes under strange circumstances. Set up networks, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover small-town mystery in this nostalgic single-player adventure sim.

Follow Leap Game Studios to discover more!
